title: Online shopping
descriptionFa: کلمه‌های سایت‌های فروش، سفارش و ارسال، و نوشتن آدرس.

words.example: I shop online because it saves time.
I always search for discount codes before I buy anything.
Every product on this website has photos and reviews.
You can return any item within fourteen days.
The price includes delivery.
Everything is half price in the sale.
words.tipFa: for sale یعنی «برای فروش»، ولی in the sale یعنی «در حراج».

words.example: I wrote a review of the restaurant online.
I have three things in my basket, but I haven't paid yet.
Choose your size and click Add to basket.
When you're ready, go to the checkout and pay.
Your order will arrive on Tuesday.
words.tipFa: فعل هم هست: I ordered a new phone case.

words.example: Please give us your order number when you email us.
Delivery takes three to five days.
words.tipFa: فعلش deliver هست: We deliver on Saturdays.

words.example: All orders over one million tomans get free delivery.
I paid a little extra for next day delivery.
Did you receive the parcel?
Is your delivery address the same as your home address?
I live at number twelve, Golestan Street.
Isfahan is a beautiful old city.
What's your post code?
words.tipFa: postcode هم سرهم می‌نویسن. آمریکایی‌ها zip code می‌گن.
